Families in Nuevo Laredo who want to build, expand or improve their homes can now get building materials at affordable prices through a new savings program from the city's housing institute, according to CML Noticias.

The program, called “Tanda de Materiales de Construcción,” is offered by the Instituto Municipal de Vivienda y Suelo Urbano (IMVISU). It works as a gradual savings plan: families make contributions based on what they can afford, and later receive the equivalent of what they saved in building materials, the institute's director, Carlos Montiel Saeb, explained.

In addition to discounted materials, IMVISU provides free technical advice to help families plan their projects properly, whether building a wall, a room or any other home improvement. The guidance covers the quantities of materials needed, approximate costs and the technical characteristics of the work, with the goal of avoiding unnecessary spending and helping families manage their resources better.

Another benefit is free processing of construction permits with the Secretaría de Obras Públicas, a step IMVISU handles for participants at no cost. The program covers materials and professional advice; the cost of labor is each beneficiary's responsibility, Montiel Saeb said.

People interested in the program can visit the IMVISU offices, located next to El Palomar, Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Information is also available by WhatsApp at 867 463 0018, where staff can explain the requirements and the procedure to participate.

Sources: CML Noticias, November 7, 2026.

title: IMVISU Offers Low-Cost Building Materials and Free Advice for Nuevo Laredo Families
